features.title: A global workspace for existing durable bots
features.summary: Open Bots without creating a native DSH Session. A provider-neutral roster shows existing identities, providers, unread counts and connection health separately from remote activity. Select a bot and provider conversation to read the bounded local cache, send text, explicitly retry the original request, or mark messages read. Narrow panes use Back navigation. No production sample identities are supplied.
failureModes: A missing Bots API owner shows unavailable and stops polling rather than crashing the slot.
Connection health never implies that the remote bot is idle or stopped.
Disconnect stops local synchronization only; removal deletes local connection/cache only, not the remote bot or vault credentials.
A transport error leaves delivery unconfirmed. Reconnect never resends; explicit retry retains the original request UUID.
Unsupported content is text-only with an original-app link only when the adapter supplied a credential-free HTTPS URL.
The displayed conversation is a bounded local projection. Since-link history is disclosed and is not advertised as a full import.

Managed reference replacement requires the current worker/session/account/grant and a canonical full-map CAS. Revocation stops new saves but does not roll back an already accepted vault call or delete credentials.

features.title: Connect through provider adapter metadata
features.summary: Choose a registered provider adapter and fill its declared fields. Credential fields accept vault references only and offer the shared secret-reference binding. The adapter risk disclosure requires explicit acceptance. No raw credential, native DSH thread, model preset or remote replacement bot is created. Supported adapters offer a separate optional, initially unchecked credential-management grant; manual references remain the default.
failureModes: No registered adapter leaves an honest unavailable message, not a fake bot or credential form.
The reference grammar is shared with credential-port. Raw tokens are rejected before a connect request.
Risk acceptance is initially false and resets when choosing another adapter.
Connection failure shows a safe generic error, never a raw provider response or submitted credential.
Connection-risk consent is not a credential-management grant. The optional vault checkbox is unchecked initially and resets when choosing another adapter.

features.title: An embeddable Node HTTP boundary over one Bots engine
features.summary: Run one provider-neutral Bots engine behind authenticated server-to-server HTTP using an injected exclusive store and adapter registry. This is not a proxy to DSH, finished Docker packaging or real provider authentication.
failureModes: Missing or invalid bearer authentication is rejected before a route performs a domain operation; browser Origin headers and query credentials are rejected.
Malformed, oversized, encoded or unfinished request bodies fail within fixed transport bounds without reflecting input or provider diagnostics.
A retry keeps the original request UUID. A changed body is refused and uncertain delivery is never automatically resent.
The caller owns durable storage and adapter registration; do not run this engine concurrently with a DSH engine over the same data.
